pages.title: The Red Land
pages.text: $(egyptian)Deshret$(), meaning "red land," is the harsh desert surrounding the fertile Nile. Its distinctive red sand and stone provide unique building materials.$(br2)$(warning)Beware:$() This region often harbors $(curse)cursed zones$().

pages.title: Deshret Materials
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Deshret Sand$(): Red sand$(li)$(item)Deshret Sandstone$(): Red stone$(li)$(item)Deshret Brick$(): Building block$(li)$(item)Deshret Cobblestone$(): Rough stone$(li)$(item)Deshret Pillar$(): Decorative$(li)$(item)Deshret Scale$(): Ornate block
